headline: Nvidia Unveils Open Models for Enterprise and On-Device AI Agents
summary: Nvidia has launched new open models to enable enterprises to run their own AI agents in-house and on personal computers, challenging proprietary platforms and promoting local deployment. This shift is driving industry discussions on transparency, cost, and control.
whyItMatters: It broadens access to advanced AI capabilities, reduces dependence on closed platforms, and opens new strategic opportunities for enterprises.
